title: SWF: ShowFrame and frame count validation
description: Test that exported SWF has the correct number of ShowFrame (tag 1) tags matching the document frame count. Verify: (1) a 1-frame document has exactly 1 ShowFrame, (2) a 5-frame document has 5 ShowFrames, (3) ShowFrame appears after all display list operations for that frame, (4) multi-scene document ShowFrame count = sum of all scene frame counts, (5) End tag (tag 0) appears exactly once at the end.
